steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: He stopped crying.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: His eyes... it's like he's braindead.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: I don't care about him. I miss Faust. He saved my life. He was a good commander.

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: Faust gave Mephisto to us... It was his last order. We're going to carry it out.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: None of my business.

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: Get out of the city with us and you have a better shot at survival.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: ...Okay. Let's go.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Where are you taking him?

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: Faust said he doesn't want us to take him back to Chernobog.

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: ...So where can he go?

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: How long were you with Faust?

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: Um... At first, I'd say he was with us.

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: Four or five years ago, Faust couldn't use any tactics and he really couldn't shoot a crossbow. We taught him all that.

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: He studied hard, trained harder, compared notes with the Yetis, sparred with Patriot's boys, and got stronger and stronger...

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: Patriot and FrostNova both taught him. He became our leader, even though we never much called him that, it's what he was.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: You lucked out.

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: No matter how Mephisto got, Faust never made us do anything.

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: Archers, don't save your high-explosive bolts.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Won't those bolts be useful against the L. G. D.?

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: Faust insisted we honor the dead like this.

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: 'It's not a waste to show respect.'

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: GreyThroat?

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: He...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: If I recall correctly, he was the crossbowman with Mephisto, and one of Reunion's commanders.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...You knew him?

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: I don't know. I'm not sure if you'd say we... knew each other.

options: It seems like there's not much Rhodes Island can do.
Have we ever actually saved any Infected?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Yeah.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: This is how it is for Rhodes Island... most of the time.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But even if there's only the tiniest bit we can do, we will do it.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We have to.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What are you thinking, Doctor?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Are you thinking about... all the death we've seen?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I can't guess. And I don't want to take it from your mind.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Because... I think one day you'll tell me yourself.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The operators have put in the work.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But death makes a heavy impression, heavier than saving someone. Every time we witness such death, it hits hard.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Just remember that without the efforts of our operators, we'd be seeing a lot more death.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: So much more death...

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: I used to think Rhodes Island fought for the Infected.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: But now I see all the dead at our feet, they're all Infected.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Amiya...

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Why does Rhodes Island fight?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Now you ask?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Blaze.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: ...Answer her.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Honestly, I ask myself the same question all the time.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We see people, Infected and uninfected, die every day.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We don't, and we shouldn't fight to stop every death. That would be meaningless in the grand scheme of things.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Like now... like in this battle in front of us.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It wasn't one crossbow, one Art, one explosion, or one wound that causes all the death.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What we fight to defeat is the source of all of this... the hatred the uninfected have for the Infected, and vice versa, is the reason they kill each other.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We must tear up the soil that nurtures the hate. Using our pharmaceuticals, and our operations.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Ah——

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Did Reunion fire that?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: That was an Originium-boosted crossbow bolt.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Pretty lousy fireworks.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Nearl said, back in Chernobog, the scaly kid was pretty strong.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: She told me her arms nearly broke. And I'll tell you from experience, I wouldn't be able to break them.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: But back there, I knew his bowstring was as good as snapped, and he didn't have much Arts left in his weapon.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: What happened to you, you little shit?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I think... maybe... he had no reason to fight anymore.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Hey, Amiya, would it be possible that he used some sort of Arts and survived from the attack?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...I'm sorry.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: What are you sorry for? I just pity the kid. Looking at him, I can tell he wasn't a bad guy.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: It's too late for any of that now.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No it's not.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The tragedies of the past carry on into the present... And we still have a chance to stop the tragedies of the future.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: I'll get his crossbow.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Did she have an epiphany?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You don't know what she's been through?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: She never shared. We're not close.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Her parents were Oripathy researchers, doing work for the Infected. They died in a clash between the Infected and police.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: She just thinks her suffering and ours are the same.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: GreyThroat is more sensitive than you give her credit for. She just doesn't express herself.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: How am I supposed to know if she doesn't speak up?
Was he your friend?

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: ...I don't know.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Who are you?
Should I introduce myself?

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: No thank you.
It's dangerous to make friends with the Infected.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: I don't care if my friends are sick or not.
You have my condolences.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Why did you ask me that?
Because I worried you were making friends with Infected.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Call for you, Amiya.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: This is Amiya.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Gavial? Where are you?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Under the slums? There's a passage? How?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Black raincoats, and...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Yeti Squad? Are they forming up with Reunion in the slums?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: ...The worst is yet to come.
